code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia (low arterial oxygen saturation and pO₂), mild anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, mild thrombocytopenia, monocytosis, basophilia, and a low arterial pH (mild acidemia). These findings suggest significant respiratory compromise with possible infection or bone marrow suppression. Immediate clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
